column1: # One row per theorem registered in CheckAxioms.lean, naming the concrete
# evidence that the theorem's hypotheses can all hold at once. Checked by
# scripts/nonvacuity_gate.py, which also requires CheckAxioms.lean and
# run_gate.sh to register the same set.
#   instance    the hypotheses are jointly satisfiable and the witnesses
#               exhibit a concrete instance satisfying them
#   necessity   the theorem REFUSES, so joint satisfiability is what it
#               denies; the witnesses show each hypothesis satisfiable on
#               its own and the refusal not universal
#   contentless the theorem is true by definition rather than by any
#               property of its subject. A FINDING, kept visible; the
#               witnesses record what it is worth and where the
#   concrete    the theorem is itself a computation on concrete data, so it
#               has no hypotheses to satisfy. Only accepted when another
#               row cites it as a witness
